remaining_blockers.name: waydroid
remaining_blockers.status_line: BLOCKED waydroid: python-gbinder/libgbinder dependency chain missing in current channels

attempts.detail: Guix survey: guix show/search/package -A confirms no waydroid package currently available.
AUR PKGBUILD review confirms dependency set includes python-gbinder and dbus-python in addition to lxc/nftables/dnsmasq/python-gobject/gtk3.
Dependency-chain probe: guix import pypi gbinder produced python-gbinder candidate, but upstream setup.py requires pkg-config libgbinder and guix show libgbinder reports package not found.

remaining_blockers.name: brscan4
remaining_blockers.status_line: BLOCKED brscan4: vendor RPM repackaging + udev/hwdb integration recipe still needed

attempts.detail: Guix survey: guix show/search/package -A found no existing brscan4/Brother SANE package.
AUR PKGBUILD analysis shows architecture-specific Brother RPM repackaging, hwdb generation script usage, and SANE library symlink handling.
Upstream payload probe confirms vendor artifact availability (brscan4-0.4.11-1.x86_64.rpm returns HTTP 200), but Guix rpm extraction/install wiring remains to be implemented.
